page.layout: One page of running text in one column. At the top, a dedication block set in larger and centred type. Below it, the body of the letter in one column. No margin notes. Printed signature at the foot.

main_text.head: KAROLO VTENHOVIO NIEVLANDIÆ &c. Dn. VIRO nobilissimo, doctissimo, IANVS GRVTERVS
main_text.p: Imocati isthac quae vides, inscripserat nomini tuo Kimedoncius noster, Colonia Agrippina redux: partim testandae gratitudini; quod dum isthic apud vos ageret, nullo non benevolentiae ac prothymiae genere cum prosecutus fueras: partim quoniam & Graecas literas, & aetatem cius, quae pueros vix exibat, optime nouisses: ideoque & errantem corrigere humaniter, & erratis committer veniam dare possis. At enim ut Menandri-no verfui fidem adstraxit:
Ὃν οἱ θεοὶ φιλᾶσιν ἀποθνῄσκει νέος,[?]

fatusque ac Deo visum, eripere ipsum rebus humanis, quū solummodo vixisset annos septemdecim, menses IX. dies VIII. quod ipsemet praepropero abitu impeditus praestare nequiit, idego nunc praesto: opus, spero & tibi pariter & defuncto gratum acceptumque. ideoq; simile quid mox facturus circa utriusq;, Philostrati Imagines, Heroica, Epistolas, &c. nec non Descriptiones Callistrati, Alciphronisque Epistolas, quae omnia vertit Latine. si minus accura-te, quid mirum? imo quid tum? fatis est aestimatio-ni hominum subiecisse, quantos qualesque fructus haec arbuscula latura fuisset, paulo maturior, quae iam tunc praecocis ingenii luxuriabat flosculis & colore simul & odore commendabilibus quo parū aetatis

page.notes: The Greek line is a Menander quotation; its exact letters (φιλᾶσιν, ἀποθνῄσκει) are read from a small scan and should be checked against the printed text. "Imocati" and "cius" are copied as printed. The line ending "quo parū aetatis" continues onto the next page, which is not on this scan. The page number is not printed; only the signature "A a" appears at the foot.
